instruments.notes: Hedges approximately 10 percent of 1998 crude production; prices are WTI-based averages; no absolute volume stated.
instruments.evidence_quote: The Company has entered into collar agreements to hedge approximately 10 percent of its 1998 crude production at an average floor price of $19.87 WTI per barrel and an average ceiling price of $21.15 WTI per barrel.

instruments.notes: Hedges approximately 25 percent of estimated 1998 U.S. gas production; prices are HH-based averages; no absolute volume stated.
instruments.evidence_quote: Approximately 25 percent of its estimated 1998 U.S. gas production is hedged using collars at an average floor price of $2.21 HH per mmbtu and an average ceiling price of $2.42 HH per mmbtu.

instruments.notes: Financial statement note: crude oil contracts at 12/31/1997 hedging about 9 percent of estimated 1998 crude oil production at an average price; instrument type not specified and may overlap with the collars described in the hedging section. instruments.evidence_quote: At December 31, 1997, the Company was a party to crude oil contracts to hedge about 9 percent of its estimated 1998 crude oil production at an average price of $20.17 per barrel.
